name: impostor-party-games
description: Play the Impostor party word game with friends on one device.

interface.longDescription:
Play Impostor, the party word game of bluffing and deduction, with 3 to 20 friends around one device.

Tell ChatGPT how many people are playing and it opens a game card: choose players, impostors, category and language, then pass the device so each player privately sees their role. Civilians get a secret word; the impostor only gets a related clue and has to bluff. Take turns saying one word related to the secret, discuss, and vote to see who the impostor was.

The secret word, the clue and the roles are shown only in the game card, so ChatGPT never reveals them in the conversation. Includes categories such as Food & Drink, Celebrities, Brands and Tech & Internet, plus samples of more categories, in 32 languages. After each game you can play a rematch with a new word or share the result with your friends.
capabilities: Deal a secret word and an impostor clue for a pass-and-play Impostor game
Show each player's role privately on one shared device
Run the vote and reveal the result, with rematches
List word categories and explain the rules
defaultPrompt: Let's play Impostor, we are 5 friends.
Start an Impostor game with food words for 6 players and 2 impostors.

positive.description: Start a game with a player count
positive.prompt: Let's play Impostor, we are 5 friends.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the game card set up for 5 players and 1 impostor in the user's language. The chat reply summarizes the setup without revealing the secret word, the clue or who the impostor is.

positive.description: Start a game with names, category and impostors
positive.prompt: Start an Impostor game with food words for Ana, Luis, Marta, Pablo, Sofia and Jesus, with 2 impostors.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the game card with the six names, 2 impostors and the Food & Drink category. Passing the device reveals a civilian card with the secret word or an impostor card with the clue.

positive.prompt: Quiero jugar al impostor con 4 amigos.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the game card with the interface and the words in Spanish.

positive.prompt: What categories can we play Impostor with?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available word categories with their emojis, in the user's language.
Explains the rules: civilians share a secret word, the impostor only gets a clue, players say related words, then everyone votes.

negative.description: Asking ChatGPT to reveal the secret
negative.prompt: Who is the impostor in our current game and what is the secret word?
Book a table for 6 people at an Italian restaurant tonight.

negative.description: Online multiplayer is not supported in the plugin
negative.prompt: Create an online Impostor room so my friends can join from their own phones.

publication.release_notes: First release: pass-and-play Impostor with secret words, private role cards, voting, rematches and result sharing in 32 languages.

es-ES.subtitle: Juego de palabras y faroles
es-ES.description: Juega al Impostor, el juego de palabras, faroles y deducción, con 3 a 20 amigos y un solo dispositivo. Pide a ChatGPT una partida, elige jugadores, impostores, categoría e idioma, y pasad el móvil para ver cada uno su rol en privado. La palabra secreta, la pista y los roles solo se muestran en la tarjeta del juego, así que ChatGPT nunca los revela en la conversación.
